gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ (inspect) twice a year for signs of corrosion.
gaps.explanation: 'Twice a year' marks a routine: present simple passive, is + inspected.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (notify) by email at the end of the week.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + notified for the plural subject 'the winners'.

gaps.sentence: The ancient scrolls are far too brittle ___ .
gaps.explanation: The scrolls receive the action: passive infinitive to be + unrolled.

gaps.sentence: My usual barber's chair ___ (fix), so I'm trying a new salon.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: is being + fixed for an unfinished, ongoing repair.

gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: The rare print ___ (steal) from the locked cabinet — the lock wasn't forced.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive: must have been + past participle for a confident past deduction.

gaps.sentence: Parcels ___ (leave) in the porch if nobody is home.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: should be + left. A recommendation; 'are left' (routine) is also acceptable.
